column1: # context: that switch's summary. Firebase is Google's notification service and ntfy is an app; both names stay as they are.

For phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram signs up an address from a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, and Telegram's servers call it to wake Telegram when something arrives. The messages still come from Telegram itself. It also turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection, unless you've set either one yourself. Turned off, Telegram goes back to Firebase the next time it starts.
column2: Para celulares onde as notificações do Firebase não chegam. O Telegram cadastra um endereço de um app de UnifiedPush como o ntfy, e os servidores do Telegram chamam esse endereço para acordar o Telegram quando algo chega. As mensagens continuam vindo do próprio Telegram. Também liga o Manter Serviço Ativo e a Conexão em Segundo Plano do próprio Telegram, a menos que você já tenha mudado algum dos dois. Desligado, o Telegram volta ao Firebase na próxima vez que abrir.

Find names in styled letters

column1: # context: Summary of Find names in styled letters. The three sample words are written in styled letters (bold, italic, wide): keep them styled, use words in your language that mean bold, italic and wide, and avoid letters with accents since those can't be styled. Highlighted means the matched part of a search result is colored

Searching your chats and contacts also finds names written in letters like 𝐁𝐨𝐥𝐝, 𝘐𝘵𝘢𝘭𝘪𝘤 or Ｗｉｄｅ when you type plain ones. Names still show as they're written and numbers aren't changed. A name found this way isn't highlighted.
